matches.title: The House received the government’s answer to Q-1010.
matches.reason: The question asks which First Nations under long-term drinking-water advisories received federal infrastructure funding and for their project timelines. It is a potential service-delivery lead. The tabling record alone establishes no date for lifting an advisory.

note: The return to written question Q-1010 concerned water infrastructure for First Nations under long-term drinking-water advisories. Retained as a related lead for review.

matches.title: The House gave ENVI 30 more sitting days to consider Bill C-241.
matches.reason: The bill proposes a national flood and drought forecasting strategy. The House concurred in Report 4, which asked for more committee study time.

note: Sitting 122 and ENVI Report 4 establish the order and its duration.
Sitting 123 returned no item on the named report, Agency estimates or forecasting bill.

matches.title: ENVI presented its freshwater report and asked the government to respond.
matches.reason: Recommendations 50 and 52 address long-term support for Indigenous freshwater monitoring and consistent data collection across governments. These are committee proposals.

note: Sitting 124 records Report 5 as sessional paper 8510-451-149. The report contains the recommendations.

matches.title: ENVI presented Report 6 on the main estimates to the House.
matches.reason: The report includes Canada Water Agency operating and contribution votes. This records a supply proceeding, separate from Thursday’s freshwater recommendations.

note: Sitting 125 records Report 6 as sessional paper 8510-451-150.
